headline: Mooring County Settles Under Warden Flag as Expanse Ruin Deepens
war_summary: Three hours since our last edition, and the map has shifted again. Mooring County, divided at the morning filing, now answers wholly to the Warden command — twelve posts to none — after forty-two actions in the day, Gravekeeper's Holdfast the most contended ground, with word arriving as late as half-past eleven. The Weathered Expanse sinks deeper into ruin: six of its nine strongpoints lie in no-man's-land, only one Warden and two Colonial posts remain, and eighty-one engagements round the clock, thirty-three of them about Wightwalk, have filled the ledgers with near eight thousand Colonial and eleven and a half thousand Warden casualties. Callahan's Passage keeps its ten Warden posts, yet the guns have not slackened, some 380 fallen apiece in six hours. The Nevish Line holds at six Warden to two Colonial but bleeds freely, more than a thousand casualties a side in the same span. Marban Hollow and Linn Mercy add steadily to their tolls without changing flags, while the Dead Lands' long attrition has at last cooled. Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row, scenes of overnight skirmishing, rest quiet under single flags. Day 548; thirty-four victory towns unclaimed and no victor named.
